secret.title: Behind the scenes
secret.locked: This page unlocks after you find all 7 secrets.
secret.noScores: No scores yet. Go play something.
secret.body: Everything in the arcade is procedural: no model files, no textures from disk. Geometry is built from primitives, labels are drawn on canvas, and the sound effects are synthesized with WebAudio.

footer.built: Built with Next.js, React Three Fiber and too much neon.
